description: This file contains shell script functions for platform upgrades, including handling of different board types, device operations such as mounting, copying, and erasing partitions, and specific upgrade procedures for SD boot and Traverse slot systems.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs upgrade on SD boot devices by writing kernel and root filesystem to specific partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_traverse_slotubi
methods.description: Handles upgrade process for systems with Traverse slots, updating UBI partitions accordingly.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to the SD boot device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup based on board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies whether the image is supported for upgrade on the current board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for performing system upgrade, delegates to specific upgrade routines based on board type.
